summary: Part 1 of 4 (00:00 to 07:12) of 2.1 Fulfillment App (KAM). All 40 frames in pack-1 were opened. The trainer explains the purpose of Fulfillment and its score rules (Drive slide 'Score logic', page 4 of 5 of Revibe documentation.pdf, visible at frame t00168), then tours the SKUs available tab of the Revibe - Fulfillment App: sorting by Quantities recommended, warranty rows, the SKU detail panel, Quantities recommended, SKU Status, download and filter, and price versus buy box. Part 1 ends mid-sentence at 07:10. Facts are stated only where speech, screen or both confirm them. The meanings of the star icon and of the other SKU statuses are not confirmed.

terms.meaning: Revibe-managed service in which sellers send their first shipments to Revibe and Revibe runs a second QC, packaging and shipping for them. Trainer says 'Fulfillment by Revive'. Used to recruit sellers, support new sellers, and manage sellers blocked for quality.
The seller ships its own orders. The score rules decide whether a seller may do it. A seller blocked for quality is barred from it.
The seller offer shown to customers. The trainer says Fulfillment has priority on the buy box over direct shipping. The price shown in the app is the price displayed in the seller's buy box.
Seller performance score in percent, shown in bands: > 0%, 0% to -5%, < -5%. A negative score is upgraded to 0% when the seller sells through fulfillment.
Revibe's lab. The trainer says it manages fulfillment, helped establish the quality guidelines, and treats invalid claims.
Recommended stock quantity per SKU: sales over the past two weeks in UAE and South Africa minus current inventory stock.
Stock keeping unit. Each row in the SKUs available list is one SKU, e.g. 9999A1-000000 or 010118-091903-TDRA.
The device is not in fulfillment at the moment. The trainer says this is the status of most devices.
A warranty SKU (category Warranty, price 9,999). The trainer says a seller cannot sell a warranty, so the rows can be ignored.
Implied: a section of the Revibe website where devices sold through fulfillment are displayed. The word before 'express section' is unreliable in the speech.
Buybox regional groups. AE = UAE + South Africa. SA = KSA + Kuwait.
The Supplier value shown on the SKU panels in this view. The trainer says he is showing the super admin view and contrasts it with the seller view.
Implied: customer claims against a seller. The trainer says fulfillment reduces the volume of claims. Invalid claims are handled by the lab.

asr_fixes.basis: Screen: app title 'Revibe - Fulfillment App' (t00000.jpg) and Drive file 'Revibe documentation.pdf' (t00168.jpg). The same mishearing recurs at 02:15 ('Fulfillment by Revive') and 03:28 ('{revive?}').

unclear.issue: 'devices sold through fulfillment are displayed on the {revive?} express section in the website': the word before 'express section' is unreliable and no frame shows the website, so the name of the section cannot be confirmed.

'the products all the ones with stars mean that we were selling more than' and '{ten?} over the past two weeks': the threshold is unconfirmed. In t00333 the star icon is visible on the rows with quantity 10 and not on the visible rows with quantity 9 or 8; stars are visible on all rows of the top frames. The speech does not state the threshold clearly, so the star meaning is not stated.
'you can see who is seeing it me': the sentence is unfinished and the meaning is unclear. It is not known what 'who is seeing it' refers to, so it is not stated.

'sellers being {code?} broken': the qualifier word is unreliable and no screen confirms it. The rule only states that sellers who cannot win orders with their buy box are restricted, so the exact label is not recorded.
'fulfillment by noon by amazon' and 'noon and {amazon?}': the name of the other marketplace's service is unconfirmed.
'like in stock or fulfillment': the speech names two other SKU statuses, but only Free market appears on screen in frames t00369 to t00410. The other status names are not confirmed.

Score logic table (Revibe documentation.pdf page 4): the small weekly-performance table on the left cannot be read at this resolution. Row labels were partly readable, but the values and the exact thresholds behind the score are not confirmed.

'So for most of the prices, for most of the SKUs where the price is {realistic?} price, sellers': the sentence is cut at the end of part 1. The rule about realistic prices is not stated here; it continues in part 2.
'when a seller gets blocked from {revive?}': the word after 'blocked from' is unreliable, so the blocking body is not stated beyond 'blocked from Revibe' as the likely reading.

outdated.signal: Score logic slide is from Revibe documentation.pdf, copyright line '© 2024' (t00168.jpg). The score bands and fulfillment countries may have changed since.
'other countries where we start shipping' refers to future expansion. The current list of fulfillment countries is not confirmed.

'then it became too big' and 'now fulfillment is restricted only to ...': the trainer describes an earlier open policy and a later restriction. The restriction is the current rule as of this video, but the wording marks a change that may be reversed.
'there will be another video only for the sellers with a seller view': refers to a separate video that is not part of this pack.
